entry_condition: M2 begins and a row is proven LEGACY_PHYSICAL_ENCODED
scope: Migration boundary resolver for journaled legacy rows only; never a product projection or generic StorageObjectId URI parser
removal_criterion: M5 has switched every active legacy reference and the observation window has no classified legacy read

entry_condition: M4 begins and deterministic evidence proves a legacy physical placement
scope: Idempotent adopt import or copy operation accepting a migration key and typed physical placement and returning logical ID plus placement receipt
removal_criterion: All adoptable legacy rows have terminal receipts and normal writers use Storage-issued IDs

entry_condition: M2 begins and comparison is required during cutover
scope: Storage-owned migration report may compare original classified value journal identity and canonical placement; it writes neither authority twice
removal_criterion: M5 reconciliation passes and no unresolved mismatch remains

entry_condition: M4 adoption succeeds but M7 cleanup gate is not yet authorized
scope: Retain legacy bytes as rollback safety without treating them as identity or serving them through permanent fallback
removal_criterion: M7 confirms canonical replica retention integrity and lifecycle authorization
